idea-plugin.name: Run Config Drift Detector
idea-plugin.description:
Run Config Drift Detector — Eliminate "Works on My Machine"

Run Config Drift Detector checks your local setup against a .run-requirements.yaml manifest committed with the project, catching JDK mismatches, missing environment variables and a wrong working directory before they cause mysterious failures.

Checks

  • JDK — project SDK major version vs. the required jdk (a missing SDK is flagged too)
  • Environment variables — every name under env_vars must be set in the IDE's environment
  • Working directory — working_dir must exist and be a directory

Reporting

  • Drift Report tool window — issues with severity, fix suggestion and a health score
  • Auto-scan on startup — notification when drift is found
  • Manual re-scan — Tools → Re-scan for Drift or the tool window button

Requirements

  • IntelliJ IDEA 2023.2+ or another IntelliJ-based IDE
  • A .run-requirements.yaml file in your project root (path configurable)

Support

  • Issues: GitHub
  • Email: support@jakubjirak.com
